items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: I like this little Joe, Joseph Jackson... Cap used to bring him over here. And, uh, played with a lot of numbers... if he get a job right now, a good job, he'll call for me. So, that's the night you should go and play with him a lot of times.

ctx.x: Of their? Cousins of ours. Yeah. And were they brothers, all of them? All of those were brothers like we were. I mean like we are.

Yeah. Now they had, uh, oh, they had, uh, uh, Jackson used to play bass with my daddy too. Mm-hmm. Yeah. He used to play, well Jackson used to play bass with my daddy. And, uh, we had a daughter, Anita Jackson, she played piano. And, uh, now she has a brother, she passed, and she has a brother, his name is Joseph Jackson, where he plays piano. He still plays.
Oh, and music hits a family, it really hits a family, doesn't it?
